title: Code: Simulate data with specified correlation

cues.en: Instructor: Now I'm going to show you a method to create data to simulate data that has a correlation coefficient that you can specify.
cues.zh: 講師：現在示範一種建立模擬資料的方法，讓資料具有你指定的相關係數。

cues.en: This is pretty useful knowing how to simulate correlated data.
cues.zh: 知道如何模擬相關資料，相當有用。

cues.en: It's really great for exploring different kinds of data analysis methods, including correlation, but also including multiple regression, which you'll learn about a bit later in the course.
cues.zh: 這很適合用來探索不同的資料分析方法，包括相關，以及課程稍後會學到的多元迴歸。

cues.en: Okay, so the way that we do this is we apply this formula here, well, this code line here.
cues.zh: 方法就是套用這裡的公式，或者說這一行程式碼。

cues.en: So I start by specifying a number of samples, and here I specify the desired correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 首先指定樣本數，再指定希望得到的相關係數。

cues.en: Now notice I'm calling this the desired correlation coefficient and not the actual correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 注意，我稱它為期望的相關係數，而不是實際相關係數。

cues.en: You will see in a few moments that these are actually a little bit different.
cues.zh: 稍後會看到，兩者其實有些不同。

cues.en: So I want a variables with 100 elements that have a correlation coefficient of 0.6.
cues.zh: 我要的是含 100 個元素、相關係數為 0.6 的變數。

cues.en: So I start by creating totally random numbers.
cues.zh: 首先建立完全隨機的數字。

cues.en: So you normally distributed random numbers, and these are probably not going to be correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 也就是常態分布的隨機數，它們彼此大概不會相關。

cues.en: So let's see, core X and Y.
cues.zh: 看看，corr X 與 Y。

cues.en: So the correlation happens to be 0.03, basically zero.
cues.zh: 相關恰好是 0.03，基本上是 0。

cues.en: So it's certainly not a correlation of 0.6.
cues.zh: 當然不是 0.6。

cues.en: Okay, so here's what we do.
cues.zh: 接著這樣做。

cues.en: You take Y and you redefine Y to be itself times the square root of one minus r squared, and then plus X times R.
cues.zh: 把 Y 重新定義為它自己乘上 1 減 r 平方的平方根，再加上 X 乘 r。

cues.en: So what we're doing here is taking our desired correlation and imposing that on the data.
cues.zh: 我們是把期望的相關施加在資料上。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna make a plot and then we can see what these data look like.
cues.zh: 然後畫圖，看看資料長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So that's pretty interesting, pretty clear that there's a modest correlation between variable X and variable Y.
cues.zh: 很有意思，X 與 Y 之間相當明顯有中等程度的相關。

cues.en: So this is just a visual confirmation, but you can't really look at a correlation plot at a scatter plot and determine the exact correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這只是視覺上的確認，因為不能光看相關圖，也就是散佈圖，就判定確切的相關係數。

cues.en: So we're gonna compute it here.
cues.zh: 因此在這裡計算。

cues.en: So let's compute it.
cues.zh: 來計算看看。

cues.en: And we find that the empirical correlation, the actual output of the core function is 0.5.
cues.zh: 發現經驗相關，也就是 corr 函式實際輸出的值，是 0.5。

cues.en: So it's actually considerably lower than 0.6.
cues.zh: 其實比 0.6 低了不少。

cues.en: Now, I'm gonna talk a lot more about this.
cues.zh: 這一點會再詳細討論。

cues.en: In fact, I'm gonna spend the rest of the video on this discrepancy.
cues.zh: 事實上，影片其餘時間都會討論這個差異。

cues.en: But before that, I want to just point out something quickly about the MATLAB core function.
cues.zh: 但在那之前，先快速指出 MATLAB 的 corr 函式的一件事。

cues.en: And the reason why I'm using this apostrophe here, which is the transpose operation, if you're not familiar with the transpose operation, it's from linear algebra
cues.zh: 這裡使用單引號，是因為那代表轉置運算。如果不熟悉，這是線性代數的運算，

cues.en: and it's pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 相當直接。

cues.en: So it just involves swapping rows and columns.
cues.zh: 就是交換列與欄。

cues.en: So imagine I have a vector like this.
cues.zh: 假設我有一個像這樣的向量。

cues.en: This is called a row vector because it's lined up as a row, and then I'm gonna put a single apostrophe afterwards and that will just transpose
cues.zh: 它稱為列向量，因為排成一列。在後面加上一個單引號，就會把

cues.en: that row vector into a column vector.
cues.zh: 這個列向量轉置成欄向量。

cues.en: Now the thing is that if you try to run, So let me take a step back and say that I created these variables, X and Y to be row vectors.
cues.zh: 問題在於，如果直接執行——先退一步說，我建立 X 與 Y 時，是把它們做成列向量。

cues.en: So you can see they're all lying flat along a row.
cues.zh: 可以看到，它們都平躺在同一列。

cues.en: Now sometimes in numerical programming and scientific coding, sometimes it doesn't matter whether you have the data organized as a row vector
cues.zh: 數值程式設計與科學程式設計中，有時資料排成列向量，

cues.en: or as a column vector, and sometimes it does matter.
cues.zh: 或排成欄向量，並沒有差別；但有時有差別。

cues.en: So there's algorithms in linear algebra where the results will be different depending on whether you're working with row vectors or column vectors.
cues.zh: 某些線性代數演算法會因為使用列向量或欄向量，而得到不同結果。

cues.en: Now it turns out that the core function is one of those functions.
cues.zh: corr 就是其中一種函式。

cues.en: So here, if I just input both those variables, I get this huge matrix, which is all NaNs.
cues.zh: 如果直接輸入這兩個變數，就會得到一個巨大的矩陣，裡面全是 NaN。

cues.en: We can see the size of this matrix.
cues.zh: 可以看一下這個矩陣的大小。

cues.en: This is a 100 by 100 matrix, and it's all NANs.
cues.zh: 這是 100 乘 100 的矩陣，裡面全是 NaN。

cues.en: NAN is not a number.
cues.zh: NaN 表示不是數字。

cues.en: So why is that the case?
cues.zh: 為什麼會這樣？

cues.en: That is not a sensible correlation between variable X and variable Y.
cues.zh: 這顯然不是 X 與 Y 之間合理的相關。

cues.en: So the reason for this is that MATLAB is getting a little bit confused.
cues.zh: 原因是 MATLAB 有一點搞混了。

cues.en: MATLAB actually thinks that we are trying to correlate two data sets with each other, two multivariate data sets, each of which have one observation
cues.zh: MATLAB 其實認為我們要計算兩個資料集之間的相關，而且是兩個多變量資料集，每個都只有一次觀察，

cues.en: and a hundred different features.
cues.zh: 卻有 100 個不同特徵。

cues.en: So if you're thinking about this as like measurements, let's say you're measuring a hundred different things from one person.
cues.zh: 用量測來想，就像從一個人身上量測 100 種不同的東西。

cues.en: Now, it's not possible to create a correlation based on just one data point.
cues.zh: 但只憑一個資料點，無法計算相關。

cues.en: So what actually is happening here is that MATLAB is working with the columns instead of with the rows.
cues.zh: 所以這裡實際上，MATLAB 是沿著欄處理，而不是沿著列。

cues.en: Now, there's a good reason for that and to understand that reason, you know, we have to get a little bit deeper into the nitty gritty of numerical processing
cues.zh: 這有其原因，但要理解原因，就必須更深入探討數值處理，

cues.en: and linear algebra, applied linear algebra.
cues.zh: 以及線性代數、應用線性代數的細節。

cues.en: So I don't wanna focus too much on that, but I do want to show this explicitly because if you're ever trying to compute a correlation between variables in MATLAB,
cues.zh: 我不想花太多時間，但想明確示範：如果你在 MATLAB 計算變數之間的相關，

cues.en: if you end up with a huge matrix of NANs where you actually expected just a correlation between two variables, then the first thing you should try doing is transposing the two variables,
cues.zh: 原本預期得到兩個變數的相關，結果卻得到巨大的 NaN 矩陣，首先可以試著把兩個變數轉置。

cues.en: and that is likely to give a more sensible result, which is what we get here.
cues.zh: 這樣通常就能得到比較合理的結果，如同這裡。

cues.en: Alright, so with that tangent aside, that's just a little bit about MATLAB coating.
cues.zh: 這段岔題只是補充一點 MATLAB 程式設計。

cues.en: With that tangent aside, I would like to go back to discuss this issue.
cues.zh: 先放下岔題，回頭討論這個問題。

cues.en: So we specified a correlation of 0.6, but in fact we got a correlation of 0.5.
cues.zh: 我們指定相關為 0.6，實際卻得到 0.5。

cues.en: Now, the reason why this happens is because this is imposing a theoretical correlation onto sampled data.
cues.zh: 原因是，這裡把理論上的相關施加到抽樣資料上。

cues.en: If we had an infinite number of data points, then we would actually get closer and closer to, well with an infinite number of data points.
cues.zh: 如果資料點無限多，就會愈來愈接近——或者說，資料點無限多時，

cues.en: We'd get exactly our desired correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 就會精確得到期望的相關係數。

cues.en: So I'm gonna try running this again just to see what the empirical correlation is now.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，看看這次的經驗相關。

cues.en: Now it's 0.65.
So that's pretty interesting that shows you that we're not necessarily underestimating the correlation and there's just gonna be some variability here.
cues.zh: 這很有意思，表示不一定總是低估相關，而是會有一些變異。

cues.en: So now to explore this a little bit more, I wanna have this simulation here where I'm going to test the errors.
cues.zh: 為了進一步探索，我要透過這個模擬測試誤差。

cues.en: And here I'm referring to the difference between the empirical correlation and the desired correlation as an error.
cues.zh: 這裡把經驗相關與期望相關的差異稱為誤差。

cues.en: So we say that is a discrepancy.
cues.zh: 也就是兩者的落差。

cues.en: So I want to compute this error as a function of N, so as a function of the number of data points.
cues.zh: 我想把這個誤差算成 N 的函數，也就是資料點數量的函數。

cues.en: So I'm going to loop over data points from five to 400, still impose a correlation coefficient of 0.6.
cues.zh: 資料點數從 5 到 400 逐一迴圈，仍然施加 0.6 的相關係數。

cues.en: And then what you can see here is this is basically all of the code that I showed above, just condensed into a few lines of code without any comments.
cues.zh: 這裡基本上就是上面展示的程式碼，濃縮成幾行，沒有註解。

cues.en: So here I create x, here I create Y, and here I compute not exactly the correlation coefficient between X and Y, but the difference, the square difference
cues.zh: 這裡建立 X，這裡建立 Y，這裡計算的不是單純 X 與 Y 的相關係數，而是相關係數

cues.en: between the correlation coefficient and the desire, this theoretical correlation coefficient here.
cues.zh: 與期望，也就是理論相關係數之間的平方差。

cues.en: And I'm squaring it for two reasons, one is that squaring is a common thing to do with errors.
cues.zh: 平方有兩個原因。首先，處理誤差時，平方是很常見的做法。

cues.en: I'll talk more about that in in OVAs and GMs and regressions.
cues.zh: 之後談 ANOVA、GLM 與迴歸時，會再說明。

cues.en: And this also gets rid of the negative sign because we don't actually care if we are overestimating or underestimating.
cues.zh: 其次，平方可以去掉負號，因為我們不在乎究竟高估還是低估。

cues.en: What we care about is that we are misestimating.
cues.zh: 我們關心的是估計有偏差。

cues.en: So that's our experiment, our simulation here.
cues.zh: 這就是這裡的實驗、模擬。

cues.en: And then I'm gonna plot these correlation errors as a function of N.
cues.zh: 接著把相關誤差畫成 N 的函數。

cues.en: Alright, so here's you see the results, and this is the sample size on the x axis and the squared divergence on the Y axis.
cues.zh: 這裡是結果。X 軸是樣本大小，Y 軸是偏差平方。

cues.en: So you can see it does look like it.
cues.zh: 可以看到，似乎確實如此。

cues.en: We're getting more accurate results as we increase the sample size, but we still can get some fairly, respectable sized divergences here,
cues.zh: 隨著樣本大小增加，結果更加準確，但這裡仍可能出現相當可觀的偏差，

cues.en: even up to a large number of samples.
cues.zh: 即使樣本數已經很大。

cues.en: So the conclusion of this video is that you now have a method to create random data with a specified correlation coefficient, but just keep in mind
cues.zh: 因此，這支影片的結論是，你現在有方法建立具有指定相關係數的隨機資料，但要記得，

cues.en: that this correlation coefficient is more of a theoretical result.
cues.zh: 這個相關係數比較偏向理論結果。

cues.en: And what you actually get in the real data is going to be somewhere close to this correlation coefficient, but it's not going to be exactly identical because we are sampling random noise.
cues.zh: 實際資料得到的值會接近這個相關係數，但不會完全相同，因為我們是在對隨機雜訊抽樣。

cues.en: So in this code, I'm starting by specifying a sample size, so a hundred samples, and here is the desired correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 這份程式碼先指定樣本大小為 100，這裡是期望的相關係數。

cues.en: So I want to end up with random numbers, two sets of random numbers that are correlated at 0.6.
cues.zh: 希望最後得到兩組隨機數，彼此的相關為 0.6。

cues.en: Now I call this the desired correlation coefficient and not the actual correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 我稱它為期望的相關係數，而非實際相關係數。

cues.en: And in a moment you will see why that is the case.
cues.zh: 稍後就會看到原因。

cues.en: So we start by generating purely random numbers.
cues.zh: 首先產生純粹的隨機數。

cues.en: So normally distributed random numbers.
cues.zh: 也就是常態分布的隨機數。

cues.en: Now at this point in the code, we wouldn't expect X and Y to be correlated with each other.
cues.zh: 程式執行到這裡時，我們不預期 X 與 Y 彼此相關。

cues.en: That is to say we would expect the correlation between X and Y to be zero plus some sampling variability.
cues.zh: 也就是預期 X 與 Y 的相關為 0，再加上一些抽樣變異。

cues.en: So no correlation between X and Y here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡 X 與 Y 沒有相關。

cues.en: Here is where we actually impose the correlation on Y.
cues.zh: 這裡才真正把相關施加到 Y 上。

cues.en: So what we do is redefine variable Y to be x plus Y, and X is scaled by the correlation.
cues.zh: 方法是重新定義 Y，讓它等於 X 加 Y，而 X 要用相關來縮放。

cues.en: So X is scaled up by the correlation coefficient, and Y is scaled down by one minus the correlation coefficient squared.
cues.zh: X 乘上相關係數，Y 則用 1 減相關係數平方來縮小。

cues.en: So we're changing the values of Y according to X and according to the desired correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 因此，我們根據 X 與期望的相關係數，改變 Y 的數值。

cues.en: And then we're plotting so we can see what these look like.
cues.zh: 接著畫圖，看看資料長什麼樣子。

cues.en: So it's pretty clear visually that there is a relationship between variable X and variable Y.
cues.zh: 從視覺上很清楚，變數 X 與 Y 之間有關係。

cues.en: Of course, just by looking at this plot, we cannot actually determine what the R value is.
cues.zh: 當然，光看這張圖無法判定實際 r 值。

cues.en: Presumably it should be somewhere around 0.6.
cues.zh: 推測應該在 0.6 附近。

cues.en: So now let's actually compute the empirical correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 現在實際計算經驗相關係數。

cues.en: So we requested a correlation of 0.6, and the actual correlation ended up being 0.52.
cues.zh: 我們要求 0.6，實際的相關卻是 0.52。

cues.en: That may seem a little strange that we get such a considerable discrepancy between the specified R and the empirical R.
cues.zh: 指定的 r 與經驗 r 之間，竟有這麼明顯的差異，可能讓人覺得奇怪。

cues.en: Now, the reason why this happens is that this is a kind of theoretical correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 原因是，這個相關係數是理論上的。

cues.en: What actually happens is that we are sub sampling from random numbers.
cues.zh: 實際上我們是從隨機數中取子樣本。

cues.en: So at the limits, if you had an infinite amount of data and then you applied this formula, you would see that the correlation matches this number exactly.
cues.zh: 在極限情況，如果有無限多資料，再套用公式，相關就會與這個數字完全相同。

cues.en: But we don't have an infinite amount of data, we have a fairly small amount of data, just a hundred points.
cues.zh: 但我們沒有無限多資料，只有相當少量的資料，也就是 100 個點。

cues.en: So let's try running this again and see what the empirical result ends up being.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，看看經驗結果會是多少。

cues.en: Okay, so that worked out pretty well actually.
cues.zh: 好，這次結果其實很不錯。

cues.en: We saw that one time it was underestimating the requested correlation and this time it was overestimating.
cues.zh: 第一次低估了要求的相關，這一次則高估。

cues.en: So we got a stronger correlation coefficient than what we actually requested.
cues.zh: 得到比實際要求更強的相關係數。

cues.en: Now, maybe this discrepancy is related to the number of samples.
cues.zh: 這個差異或許與樣本數有關。

cues.en: Maybe if we had a larger sample size, we would have smaller discrepancies between the correlation we requested and the correlation in the empirical data.
cues.zh: 如果樣本大小更大，要求的相關與經驗資料中的相關，差異或許會比較小。

cues.en: So to explore that possibility, I'm going to set up this experiment here where we are going to test errors as a function of ends.
cues.zh: 為了探索這個可能性，設計這個實驗，把誤差當成 N 的函數來測試。

cues.en: So I'm referring to these errors as this difference here, the difference between the correlation we specified and the correlation we got in the random data.
cues.zh: 這裡所謂的誤差，就是指定的相關與隨機資料實際得到的相關之間的差異。

cues.en: So the way I'm doing this experiment is by generating some random ends from, or sorry, specifying
cues.zh: 實驗方式是產生一些隨機的 N——抱歉，是指定

cues.en: that the ends should go from five to 400.
So a sample size of five up to a sample size of 400.
cues.zh: 也就是樣本大小從 5 到 400。

cues.en: And now I'm gonna leave the correlation coefficient fixed at 0.6.
cues.zh: 現在把相關係數固定在 0.6。

cues.en: And then in this loop over these different ends, these different sample sizes, I have these three lines of code, which is almost exactly the three lines of code
cues.zh: 對不同 N、不同樣本大小迴圈，裡面這三行程式碼，幾乎就是課程先前出現的

cues.en: that I had earlier in the course.
cues.zh: 三行程式碼。

cues.en: Earlier in this video.
cues.zh: 我是說，這支影片稍早。

cues.en: So nothing really new here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡沒有真正的新東西。

cues.en: This line is a little bit different.
cues.zh: 這一行有些不同。

cues.en: So you can see I'm computing the correlation coefficient between X and Y, but for this simulation, we don't actually care about the correlation itself.
cues.zh: 可以看到，這裡計算 X 與 Y 的相關係數，但這個模擬並不真正關心相關本身。

cues.en: Instead, what we care about is this discrepancy.
cues.zh: 我們關心的是落差。

cues.en: So I'm subtracting that empirical correlation coefficient from R, the theoretical coefficient and then squaring that.
cues.zh: 因此用理論係數 r 減去經驗相關係數，再平方。

cues.en: And there's two reasons to square that error.
cues.zh: 誤差平方有兩個原因。

cues.en: One is that squared error terms are commonly used in statistics.
cues.zh: 第一，統計學很常使用平方誤差項。

cues.en: You will see more of that when I talk about Inova and GLM and regression.
cues.zh: 之後談 ANOVA、GLM 與迴歸時，你會看到更多。

cues.en: And also the reason for squaring it is that it gets rid of the minus sign because we don't actually care if the empirical correlation is lower or higher
cues.zh: 另一個原因是平方可以去掉負號，因為我們不在乎經驗相關比期望相關

cues.en: than the the desired correlation.
cues.zh: 更低還是更高。

cues.en: We just care about the discrepancy.
cues.zh: 只在乎兩者的差異。

cues.en: All right, so that's our experiment.
cues.zh: 好，這就是實驗。

cues.zh: 現在執行，看看結果，相當有意思。

cues.zh: 一般而言，這些平方偏差，

cues.en: So the conclusion of this video is that you now have a method to create random data that have a specified correlation coefficient,
cues.zh: 所以，這支影片的結論是，你現在有方法建立具有指定相關係數的隨機資料，

cues.en: but keep in mind that the actual empirical correlation with this random sample of data is going to be close to, but not exactly this desired correlation coefficient.
cues.zh: 但要記得，這份隨機樣本實際的經驗相關，會接近期望的相關係數，卻不會與它完全相同。
